import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    sums = defaultdict(float)
    stdin = sys.stdin.buffer
    header = stdin.readline()
    for line in stdin:
        if not line:
            continue
        # id,cat,val
        c1 = line.find(b',')
        c2 = line.find(b',', c1 + 1)
        cat = line[c1 + 1:c2]
        val = float(line[c2 + 1:])
        sums[cat] += val

    out = sys.stdout.write
    for cat in sorted(sums):
        out(f"{cat.decode()},{sums[cat]:.2f}\n")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
